name: chain
description: Pipeline runner: chain tool calls where each step's output feeds the next. Steps can be tools (via ck_tool) or inline LLM mutates. Supports {{prev}} / {{prev.field}} / {{vars.key}} substitution and named chains from chains/*.json. Use {steps:[{tool,args}|{mutate:{instruction,mode}}]} or {chain:"name", vars:{}} or {list:true}/{show:"name"}.
llm_description: Pipeline runner: chain tool calls where each step's output feeds the next. Steps are tools (via ck_tool) or inline LLM mutates. Supports {{prev}}/{{prev.field}}/{{vars.key}} substitution and named chains from chains/*.json. Input: {steps:[{tool,args}|{mutate:{instruction,mode?:'json'(default)|'text'}},stop_on_error?]} or {chain:'name', vars:{}} or {list:true} or {show:'name'}.

tool.description: Tool to invoke. Mutually exclusive with mutate.

args.description: Args for the tool. String values may contain {{prev}} / {{prev.path}} / {{vars.key}}.
